inventoryMethod: Deduplicated git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- packages/api; whole-text import/framework/runtime-marker scans of every safe owned text file. Complete content review only for R rows. No execution, application imports, checks, tests, SQL, network, real environment/data/credential reads, Git mutations or nested agents.

encoding.R: reviewedcontent: complete safe content returned and reviewed; also text-scanned
encoding.S: scan-only: whole safe text searched for imports/framework/runtime markers; not semantic acceptance
encoding.X: excluded: filename/metadata only; no content read
encoding.resolution: Every file inherits frameworkDependency, targetPath, preservationAction, blocker and owner from its class; exact path overrides and sourceFamilyTargets below refine these fields. {path} means the full original path. Targets are proposals or existing reuse, never relocation/export/mount authority.
encoding.dependencyLimit: Class frameworkDependency denotes the module boundary, not a claim that every file directly imports that library. Critical direct/runtime/type-only edges are separately recorded. Empty findings never imply transitive browser purity.
